prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1434; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented after a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported shoulder complaint. Over four visits, care consisted of conservative management including rest, activity modification, and a short course of anti-inflammatory medication with gentle range-of-motion exercises. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient progressed. The patient reports ongoing pain, and nearly all of the documented symptoms rest on the patient's own description of discomfort. Shoulder imaging and the orthopedic provocative tests performed were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder is known. Billing records reflect one charge per visit with no duplicated or repeated services. Plan going forward is home exercise and follow-up as needed.
